title: Apple, Samsung and Google face potential device ban in the US
description: A new investigation by the US International Trade Commission (USITC) over spatial audio patent infringement could result in bans for Apple, Samsung and Google devices in the US. BoomCloud 360 is a relatively small audio company based in California which focuses on cloud sound optimization software for movies, games and music. It also holds valuable patents in the domain of spatial audio, which have been the subject of the ongoing probe. The original complaint was filed back in August and includes three patent disputes which BoomCloud 360 claims are being infringed upon by devices...

title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro and S27 Ultra's battery capacities and charging specs revealed
description: Samsung's upcoming Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra have just been certified for sale in China by 3C. This has revealed the fact that they both support 60W wired charging, just like this year's Galaxy S26 Ultra. Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro and S27 Ultra charging specs But while there's no change there, there is an exciting one in the battery capacity department. The 3C has also seemingly certified the duo's batteries, and the S27 Ultra's is rated at 5,534 mAh. The refresh rate will actually climb up to 185Hz in specific games. The phone will have a 9,000 mAh battery with support for 100W wired and 50W wireless charging. description: The Oppo K14 series is set to get another member in India. Following the recent launch of the K14 Lite, the company has now started teasing a new K14 Plus variant. The lineup also includes the K14 and K14x. Oppo has teased the launch of the new smartphone on social media, although the company has not revealed many details yet. The teaser image does suggest that the K14 Plus will be available in at least Orange and Gray colorways. The phone also appears to feature a flat frame. description: Lava launched the Bold N4 Lite in late August, and very soon it will be joined by the Bold N4 Pro in the company's lineup in India. Ahead of its launch, a special microsite on Amazon has revealed all of its specs, as well as the launch date and price, so buckle in and let's take a look. title: Android-powered Arc X1 gaming handheld launches with 7-inch display, Snapdragon G2 Gen 2
description: India-based gaming company Arc has introduced its first gaming handheld, the Arc X1. The device is powered by Qualcomm’s Snapdragon G2 Gen 2 chipset and runs OwlOS, a custom Android based operating system developed specifically for the handheld. The Snapdragon G2 Gen 2 chipset is paired with 8GB of LPDDR5X RAM and 128GB of UFS 3.1 internal storage. The handheld also features a microSD card slot for storage expansion. title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro series goes on sale
description: Following their announcement last week and a subsequent six-day pre-order campaign, the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max are now available for purchase across the first wave of 65 countries. The list includes Australia, Canada, China, Colombia, France, Germany, India, Japan, Malaysia, Mexico, Singapore, South Korea, Thailand, Turkey, the UAE, the UK, the US, and Vietnam, amongst others. description: Honor is gearing up to launch the X9e Pro in Malaysia and has been teasing the device on social media. The phone is set to launch next week, but several details about the handset have already surfaced online ahead of the unveiling. description: Xiaomi's 17 Pro and 17 Pro Max popularized the rear screen idea last year, and the company is getting ready to launch their successors later this month. Meanwhile, Honor has apparently been inspired by Xiaomi, and it's now working on at least one device with a rear screen of its own. description: Yesterday, the upcoming Xiaomi 18 Pro was seemingly spotted in the Geekbench online database, and today it's the turn of its bigger sibling, the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max, to surface in the same place. description: The new Pixel 11 series is now out so new and returning customers have started making their comparisons. title: Samsung to outsource all of its DRAM manufacturing and focus on HBM production
description: The AI race is heating up, and so is the demand for hardware required to support it. That's why companies that produce HBM memory chips like Samsung have benefited immensely in the last few years. So it's only logical for Samsung to shift its focus to HBM memory production, as this is the company's best-performing business lately. According to inside sources, Samsung is already in talks with its partners, urging them to finish their DDR5 production lines ahead of schedule and is looking to invest in new outsourced production lines as well. title: iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max pre-orders in China eclipse the 2025 Pros
description: Pre-orders in the US may have been less than stellar, but the new iPhone 18 Pro models are a huge hit in China. Local publications report that a total of over 7 million units have been pre-ordered across all channels. Pre-orders for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max started late in the evening of September 12 (Saturday) at 8pm. Retailer JD ran out of available units in under a minute. We don’t know how many units JD had on hand, but there are similar stories from other retailers. description: Snap, formerly known as Snapchat, spun off Specs, the division responsible for its augmented reality (AR) glasses, early this year, and now it's ready to take pre-orders for the upcoming product, which is also called Specs, just to be confusing. These are $2,195 standalone AR glasses that don't require a phone or computer connection to work. description: Samsung started rolling out the One UI 9 update for the Galaxy S26, S26+ and S26 Ultra yesterday (the S26 FE came with One UI 9 out of the box). title: Bose unveils new Ultra Open Earbuds and Sport Open Earbuds
description: Today Bose has unveiled the new Sport Open Earbuds and the Ultra Open Earbuds. Both of these are "designed to create more listening moments across active pursuits and everyday life", the company says. These second-generation Ultra Open Earbuds represent Bose's new flagship open-ear experience, while the new Sport Open Earbuds are the more affordable (yet still not cheap) option. The Ultra Open Earbuds have a newly engineered driver that delivers deeper bass and a higher volume than the first-gen model. description: The upcoming vivo X500 has seemingly been spotted in the Geekbench online database with the model number V2609A. As you can see in the screenshot below, the device managed a single-core score of 2,694 and a multi-core score of 7,770 in Geekbench 6.7.1 for Android.
